evidence.reason: The launch record write at lines 714-715 occurs after Popen() and before the cleanup try at line 716. If Recorder.append raises, execution never reaches the cleanup block that stops the scope and terminates/reaps the child, and the finally that closes the log is also bypassed. The child can therefore survive the failed boot and start QEMU later, which is an ordinary resource/process-leak defect in the existing intended cleanup behavior. Moving the record write inside the cleanup-protected block fixes it without changing successful-path behavior.
